title: Understanding Granularity
text: Granularity refers to the level of detail in the data. Consider what unique combinations of columns define a single entry in the DataFrame.

title: Identifying Unique Combinations
text: Look at the columns that can uniquely identify each row. Which columns, when combined, make each row distinct?

title: Analyzing Columns
text: Which columns in the DataFrame are necessary to uniquely identify each fruit at a specific location?
